original.verbatim: We investigated the biological functions of the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) through the use of Gene Ontology (GO). This allowed us to determine the primary cell components (CC), molecular functions (MF) and biological processes (BP) that were associated with our target gene. Additionally, we analyzed the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathways to gain insight into the signaling pathways in which the target gene was involved. To conduct this analysis, we utilized the "Bioconductor" and "Cluster Profiler" packages within R 3.6.1 software.

This is a common method used to annotate genes and explore their biological attributes. We showed statistically significant biological process and pathway terms for DEGs. Based on the cumulative hypergeometric distribution test, a P value of less than 0.05 was considered statistically significant for the observed differences.

We conducted our analysis using the clusterProfiler R package (4.4.4) in R version 4.2.1. Differences with a p.adjust value less than 0.05 and an FDR (q-value) less than 0.25 were considered statistically significant.
